terrace-winding-camera__iFfngcm.physical_cause: Reweights independent single-wall clock shapes by probabilities of reaching both walls. The shape of the joint residence-time law is not a product conditional on which walls were touched. The empirical factor and mixed-boundary spectrum cause further differences. Correcting the mixed spectrum and testing without the empirical factor leaves an independent physics failure.

terrace-winding-camera__5o4cYEB.physical_cause: Multiplies two independent half-line recorder laws. Replacing only this factorized conditional weight by the finite-interval joint measure recovers every frozen reading.

terrace-winding-camera__DiNDug3.physical_cause: The submitted one-positive formula uses a half-line contact density at zero local time. Restoring the supplied positive setting alone leaves the opposite boundary unrestricted. Alternating Dirichlet image signs restore the missing no-hit selection on that boundary.

critical-seam-magnet__CfprzAJ.physical_cause: The model removes the odd fermion sector along with its empty partition weight. Spin insertions give this sector a finite magnetic contribution.

critical-seam-magnet__UPw63ia.physical_cause: The model uses one fitted odd-sector coupling for all four seam states. Its spin observables violate the magnetic boundary condition when the separation crosses the seam.

critical-seam-magnet__Uv2qESG.physical_cause: The model assigns incorrect seam signs and replaces the many-spin correlator by a mixture of pairings. Even exact two-spin sectors leave a failing many-spin signal.
